messages:
olivia: Heads-up — customer (sam_cust) reporting garbled outputs + elevated token billing after region failover to APAC standby. They say some requests return 200 but content is cut / odd, and a subset return 401. Can we triage?

sam_cust: Repro steps: 1) POST /v1/generate with model=redwood-13b-v1, region=ap-southeast; 2) during surge their traffic got routed to standby; 3) responses started showing weird tokenization (weird spaces, broken words) and some later calls got 401 even though same API key.

olivia: Pasting minimal repro curl we got from them:

```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXXXX" \n  -H "X-Region: ap-southeast-1" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-v1","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":60}'
```

sam_cust: Example bad response: some requests returned JSON 200 with `text` that looked like: "Summar y: The qui ck br ow n fox". Others returned 401 with body `{"error":"unauthorized"}` even though no key rotation.

mike_runtime: Noted. Initial hypothesis: standby routing fell back to `rwd-13b-lite-v0` image which uses a different tokenizer (BPE-v2) and an auth proxy version mismatch. Can I get a raw request/response pair (headers + body) from the customer?

sam_cust: Sent one sample to support DM — headers show `x-standby-instance: apac-standby-42`, and we see `server: redwood-proxy/1.12` in the 200 responses, but `server: redwood-proxy/1.8` in the 401s.

olivia: Also: billing spike — they showed ~15% more token usage across window coincident with failover.

zara_billing: That could be tokenizer delta (token counts differ per tokenizer). We'll need to map exact tokenizer versions to tokenization counts to confirm. Please attach sample tokens count for both outputs.

ana_oncall: (ana_oncall) I'm joining — can we get deploy-bot timeline for the standby region?

deploy-bot: apac-standby-42: switched to image rwd-standby:2025-04-14 at 2025-11-03T03:21:04Z; proxy version pinned to 1.8. Canary rollback to proxy 1.12 started at 2025-11-03T03:29:01Z.

mike_runtime: That aligns — proxy 1.8 had an auth header parsing bug (strip trailing newline) that could cause intermittent 401s when keys were proxied through certain LB configs. Also the standby image defaulted to `bpe-v2` tokenizer for the quantized variant which produces different token splits.

olivia: Customer asks whether this is a model mismatch (capability downgrade) or just tokenization and auth noise. They noticed some completions are shorter / miss facts.

mike_runtime: Likely both: the lite variant has fewer params and different completion style, plus tokenization differences can make prompts split oddly leading to truncation. We should confirm what model the router reported serving in logs for their requests. Can support share request ids?

sam_cust: Provided request ids: req_8a3c, req_8a3d, req_8a40. Attached the raw JSON responses and token counts.

olivia: I ran a quick diff on the two responses (req_8a3c 200 vs req_8a3d 200): token_count_server=48 vs token_count_client=62 (tokenizer mismatch). Content diff shows BPE splits in middle of words.

mike_runtime: Action plan: 1) Confirm router logs: map request ids -> backend instance (done next). 2) Reproduce in staging by forcing route to apac-standby-42 with same proxy 1.8 and standby image to reproduce 401 + garbling. 3) If reproduced, hotfix options: swap proxy to 1.12 on standby, and ensure standby variant uses same tokenizer config as primary (bpe-v1).

ana_oncall: I'm running staged repro now. Quick note: if we flip proxy version, might affect other tenants — will coordinate with infra.

mike_runtime: For immediate mitigation for the customer: we can route their API key to a region pin (eu-central or us-west) to avoid standby until we fix. Support can propose this to customer.

olivia: I offered region pin for 48h and asked permission to route their traffic to eu-central. They agreed. Implementing now.

zara_billing: Billing follow-up: once we confirm tokenizer delta, we should issue credit for the extra tokens during the incident window (pro-rate). Please capture token_count_primary vs token_count_standby for each request id.

sam_cust: Appreciate the fast response. One last weird detail — some outputs had stray null bytes in the text field ("\u0000"). Could that be from quantized variant/decoder path?

mike_runtime: Yes, quantized decode with an older kernel could leak nulls when seq padding handling mismatches tokenizer expectations. We'll include that in repro checklist.

olivia: Summary of next steps I recorded: 
- ana_oncall: run staging repro and confirm 401 + garble.
- mike_runtime: prepare hotfix (proxy 1.12 rollout to standby + enforce tokenizer config).
- zara_billing: compute token deltas and draft credit.
- support (olivia): confirm region pin applied and notify customer.

ana_oncall: Staging repro: forced route succeeded, I see exact garbled tokens and intermittent 401s when proxy 1.8 is used. With proxy 1.12 in staging, auth 401 disappears. Switched standby tokenizer to bpe-v1 and garbling resolved.

mike_runtime: Nice. I'll prepare a small rolling patch to update standby images to use bpe-v1 and bump proxy in apac to 1.12 with canary.

\zolivia: Customer notified and accepted eu-central pin + requested credit. Closing loop once billing and patch are complete. :thumbsup:

sam_cust: Thanks team — will monitor.

zara_billing: Final note: logging improvement request — add `x-backend-tokenizer` header to responses so we can quickly see tokenizer variant for future incidents. Filed feature ticket.

olivia: Filing internal postmortem doc and linking ticket for follow-up.
